evidence_quotes: niet naar waarheid opmaken van Vervoersbewijzen Dierlijke Meststoffen (VDM)
rationale: The decision concerns administrative fines under Articles 53, 55 and 56 of the Dutch Uitvoeringsregeling Meststoffenwet (Fertilisers Act implementation regulation) for failing to properly record solid manure transport data via GPS/automatic data registration equipment and inaccurately completing animal manure transport documents (VDM). Under the protocol rules, disputes under the Dutch Meststoffenwet regarding agricultural manure regulation are classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
